The '''Ventil system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]]<ref name="GMK" /> of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="TEA-OC" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Trax Sector Force|forces]] operating in the Trax [[Sector/Legends|sector]] docked their [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] in the Ventil system.<ref name="GMK" />
